_about: Divine epiphanies and the cards that can get them. Each effect has the conditions of the game's divine epiphany table (datamine: arca.live/b/chaoszeronightmare/157993488): card type, cost range, what the card must do (cure: heals, shield: gives a shield, draw: draws, targetable: the card hits one chosen enemy — a version hitting all enemies has none (Devil Dice V), a version saying nothing of a target keeps its base card's (Soulfire Dance IV, a Skill that only draws, gets the Coordinated Attack)); forbids: what the card must not do (a card that already draws gets no draw effect; taking a card from the Draw Pile to hand counts as a draw: the neutral card Attack! gets none). A neutral card gets the same effects, Caligo's Treated as a Neutral Card included (Attack!). Every effect of a card's pool has the same chance (1 / size of the pool). An X-cost card counts as 0 (Soulfire Dance IV: Gain 1 AP, no Reduce Cost). A divine epiphany only goes on a card that has an epiphany (its own I–V or a common one). gods: "all" = each of the six gods offers it. seen: cards whose in-game probability screen shows it (screenshots; the screen leaves out an effect the card already has, for every god), the proof that the effect and its conditions are right. excludeCards: card versions ("Name II") the game leaves it out for although they meet the conditions (an exclusion tag of the card).
